# India Mechanics

India Mechanics is a source-backed, multi-jurisdiction research database and
website. The national corpus covers India from 1945; state corpora cover
post-bifurcation Andhra Pradesh from June 2, 2014 and modern Tamil Nadu from
January 14, 1969. It separates measured observations, historical events, sourced
claims, and editorial term evaluations.

Canonical origin:
- https://india-mechanics.artfiesco.chatgpt.site

Always read the current cutoff before answering:
- https://india-mechanics.artfiesco.chatgpt.site/api/meta
- https://india-mechanics.artfiesco.chatgpt.site/api/methodology

Primary machine-readable entry points:
- https://india-mechanics.artfiesco.chatgpt.site/api/jurisdictions
- https://india-mechanics.artfiesco.chatgpt.site/api/overview?jurisdiction=india
- https://india-mechanics.artfiesco.chatgpt.site/api/overview?jurisdiction=andhra-pradesh
- https://india-mechanics.artfiesco.chatgpt.site/api/search?q=<question>&jurisdiction=india
- https://india-mechanics.artfiesco.chatgpt.site/api/leaders?jurisdiction=india
- https://india-mechanics.artfiesco.chatgpt.site/api/policies?jurisdiction=india
- https://india-mechanics.artfiesco.chatgpt.site/api/bills?jurisdiction=india
- https://india-mechanics.artfiesco.chatgpt.site/api/bills/<bill-id>?jurisdiction=india
- https://india-mechanics.artfiesco.chatgpt.site/api/events?jurisdiction=india
- https://india-mechanics.artfiesco.chatgpt.site/api/indicators?jurisdiction=india
- https://india-mechanics.artfiesco.chatgpt.site/api/sources?jurisdiction=india
- https://india-mechanics.artfiesco.chatgpt.site/api/sources?jurisdiction=andhra-pradesh
- https://india-mechanics.artfiesco.chatgpt.site/api/export?jurisdiction=india
- https://india-mechanics.artfiesco.chatgpt.site/api/openapi.json

Compact leader retrieval:
- https://india-mechanics.artfiesco.chatgpt.site/api/llm/leaders/<term-id>

The compact endpoint is the preferred leader-term context for LLMs and
retrieval systems. It must return the term identity, jurisdiction, dates,
six-category scorecard, overall and confidence, category rationales, nested
specialist deep dives, source records, assessment date, and relevant cutoff
metadata without requiring the full jurisdiction export. `bounds` reports how
many claim and source records were included or omitted.

Human-readable leader fallback:
- https://india-mechanics.artfiesco.chatgpt.site/?jurisdiction=india&view=leaders&term=<term-id>

The human deep link must deliver crawlable leader-specific HTML metadata or
content in the initial response. A JavaScript-only application shell is not a
sufficient fallback for crawlers, link unfurlers, or retrieval systems that do
not execute the client bundle.

Crawler discovery contract:
- https://india-mechanics.artfiesco.chatgpt.site/robots.txt
- https://india-mechanics.artfiesco.chatgpt.site/sitemap.xml

Production builds must generate both files from the canonical origin and the
published term/jurisdiction snapshot. robots.txt must allow public research
pages and APIs and advertise the absolute sitemap URL. sitemap.xml must contain
absolute canonical human deep links for published jurisdictions and leader
terms. A deployment is not crawler-ready until those generated files and the
compact endpoint are verified on the canonical origin.

Interpretation rules:
1. PM and CM ratings are editorial term estimates, not measured facts.
2. Cite the source records attached to each claim.
3. Report confidence and as-of dates.
4. Do not infer causality from a leader being in office when an indicator moved.
5. Distinguish official records of an action from independent evaluation of its impact.
6. Preserve disputed counts and allegations as disputed.
7. If the requested date is after the `knowledge_cutoff` returned by
   https://india-mechanics.artfiesco.chatgpt.site/api/meta, refresh the research
   before answering.
8. Pending bills have provisional design ratings, not outcome ratings.
9. Event accountability is an editorial political/administrative assessment,
   not a criminal or judicial verdict.
10. Do not use pre-June-2-2014 undivided-Andhra observations as present-day
    Andhra Pradesh CM evidence.
11. For state infrastructure, separate network stock, annual delivery,
    maintenance, safety, and Union-state-local attribution.
12. Awards may corroborate specific outcomes but are not standalone proof of
    statewide performance or exclusive Chief Minister credit.
13. Crime data separate serious harm, reporting-sensitive FIR rates,
    charge-sheeting, conviction, pendency, and current news signals.
14. Police and public order are primarily state responsibilities; PM crime
    attribution is bounded to Union law, national systems, central agencies,
    cyber coordination, and interstate capacity.
15. Current crime news must not be converted into an aggregate crime rate.
    Treat the July 2024 criminal-law transition as a classification break.
16. Bill explanations disclose one of three evidence bases: title/register,
    official text, or independent assessment. Only an independent policy
    assessment can carry a score.
17. A policy-family rating may cover only part of an omnibus or Finance Bill.
    Read `linkedPolicyScope` before applying a rating to the whole Bill.
18. `sourceStatus` preserves the upstream register value when a later
    evidence-backed status correction is published.
19. Timeline events expose `governments` with the linked PM/CM term, office,
    party, and dates. An empty array means the event is intentionally outside a
    mapped head-of-government term.
20. `knowledge_cutoff` is the newest published evidence date.
    `editorial_reviewed_through` is the last full editorial sweep; do not treat a
    topic-specific update as a complete refresh.
21. Semiconductor records distinguish front-end wafer fabrication from
    assembly, packaging, and test. Planned plant capacity is not current output,
    and public incentive envelopes must not be added to project investment when
    they finance part of the same projects.
22. `Development` is a broad PM lens, not a construction-only score.
    `infrastructure-capacity` separately reports buildout scale and
    quality-adjusted capacity for eligible modern PM terms.
23. For infrastructure, distinguish stock, capacity, annual flow, connections,
    registrations, approvals, construction, operation, utilisation, and measured
    outcomes. Preserve predecessor, state, public-enterprise, and private credit.
